name: google-workspace
description: Operate Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Calendar resources available to the connected Google account through direct Google APIs.

interface.shortDescription: Work with accessible Drive and Calendar data.
interface.longDescription: Direct Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Calendar tools that follow the connected account's Google permissions, with risk-aware writes.
defaultPrompt: Find a document I can access in Google Drive.
Append these rows to a Google Sheet I can edit.
Show my upcoming events from an accessible calendar.
